forbiddenInputs: Historical Gravity Main Pipe Layer 4 geometry or measured/recorded polyline length
Historical pipe orientation, shape, route, benchmark comparison
Geographic basemap pixels as an engineering route prior

formulas.length: Spherical Haversine shortest WGS84 endpoint distance using R = 6,371,008.8 m. Appropriate as short-scale geometric baseline, not survey-grade measurement.
formulas.bearing: Initial great-circle azimuth, degrees clockwise from geographic north. Computed from two manhole top positions, NOT a documented pipe opening bearing.
formulas.invertDrop: MH-42 OUT-01 invert RL - MH-45 IN-01 invert RL
formulas.slope: invertDrop / endpoint straight-line distance * 100. This is a hypothetical straight-line segment gradient, not a surveyed pipe slope.
formulas.coverDepth: Manhole top/cover RL minus selected documented opening invert RL; not vertical pipe cover over crown.

checks: Exactly two documented manholes and WGS84 coordinates present
One matching OUT-01 on MH-42 and IN-01 on MH-45
Diameter values match within 0.1 mm and are strictly positive
Invert difference positive for selected direction
No current field measurement or vertical datum verified
caveats: Manholes and their outlet/inlet roles were preselected using earlier exploration, so connectivity is not a discovery by the algorithm.
Straight-line segment lies on endpoints by construction; benchmark agreement is not independent proof of route detection.
No hydraulic flow, roughness, terrain, alternative-route calculation, pipe-penetration survey, or accuracy calibration is performed in Phase 2A.
Original Pipe 56 historical geometry is withheld by app workflow, but public GitHub reference and earlier exposure prevent calling this a genuinely prospective blind study.
A structural GIS agreement target does not establish real-world buried utility accuracy.
evaluationStep: Validation stays disabled. Do not reveal withheld GIS geometry until calculations are frozen and a validation stage is started separately.
output: subterra-pipe56-phase2a-result/v1 — stored once in local project blindCase.phase2 and independently exportable as JSON
